SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-VER1C-C3-COLUMN-FOLD-A.note: Four TRAIN Fold A rows (the COMP-1b Fold A smoke prefix) prove FORM and nothing else: the phase-native-module-v1-c4 program loads, the 3 Solver template arms fan out at the one Solver visit, every arm fits its estimated bound, the arm receipt (saea-supply-variant-arms-v4) and I7v seal, and the episode completes. Scored by no one, read by no one.

VER-1c (level: node column, K = 3 Solver template arms: the R1 candidate r1-c3, the aa twin, the lock). Its role is the VERDICT SOURCE of the VER-1 rule on TRAIN Fold A (the c3 presence verdict feeds the offline composer's --verdict-run); it claims no benefit and nominates nothing, so expected_effect_pp is 0 and claims_benefit is false (the claim field carries the design's ceiling 'nominated', the only value the registration gate admits for a node column; this cell's reading is descriptive). The provisional floor SLU 1.49 pp is borrowed from same-flight-supply-variant (the NX R1 iteration 1 and 2 flights have flown, but their official-score twin nulls are read, not re-used here). The rule that the column feeds was FIXED on SLURP-EVO-FOLD-B-V2; the read roster is SLURP-EVO-FOLD-A-V2. the R1 c3 template (r1-c3) was authored from AGGREGATE contrast tables computed on TRAIN Fold A (the R1 tuning roster, docs/readiness/2026-10-09-slurp-nx-r1-solver-candidates-v1/README.md), which is this cell's read roster, and then measured on TRAIN Fold B by the NX R1 flights; no utterance text, gold value or note body was read to author it. The VER-1 rule (support filter, c3 verdict x N1 gate, v4g) was FIXED on TRAIN Fold B; the Fold A read here is therefore a confirmation of the RULE on a roster the rule's thresholds never saw, but not an independent roster for the c3 TEMPLATE's authoring tables. The delivered row is the lock arm: delivered intent and SLU are identical by construction at the request level (invariant I7; reported, never contrasted).

agreement_source.embedded_signal: derived: the share of this row's own top-20 sealed TRAIN-exemplar recall whose frozen build-time task_target equals each boundary intent, self-excluded by the row's utterance identity and normalised to 1. Speech-keyed by construction -- the recall it summarises is the row's own sealed speech vector against the frozen pool -- and gold-free: the key is a released store property, never a label, transcript or future turn. Built model-free by scripts/build_slurp_intent_exemplar_agreement.py with zero model, server, encoder, embedder, scorer, network and GPU contacts; receipt beside the artifact.
